title: Affine detector count on the radical-asymmetric construction
description: Combines two independent refinements of Hailey Collet's Cycle61. timbalud's radical-asymmetric-count-20261014 (marked high-zero counting with coupled radical allocation) raises the affine constant of Cycle61's initial affine moment (Theorem 2.2) to B = B0 + 7/10000. DaysSky's detector-affine-c0125154 applies that affine moment inside the detector's per-fiber count, with plain capacity (B-2m)/Λ. Here the detector count uses timbalud's larger B. On the region δ ∈ [89/200, 49/100], p ∈ [199/400, 1/2], it is the κ-independent closed form R_New. Together the two give θ = 8748389/10000000 with h = 7951/10000 and d₋ = h - 1/1000. The proof is timbalud's source tree, with the detector-affine modules ported onto it. Every endpoint row, region and scalar check is regenerated at the new endpoint with exact Bernstein certificates. AI disclosure: DaysSky with Claude assistance.
